svg.title: Prithvi Raghu: research and selected work
svg.desc: I research quantum machine learning and scientific computing. I build quantum convolutional networks, study multiplayer quantum games and compare circuit encodings for option pricing. I also model HF radio propagation and evaluate ionospheric corrections for emitter geolocation. Quantum games (QHD): equilibrium analysis and recorded IBM Heron experiments for multiplayer quantum games, with a co-authored manuscript. Quantum ML (FQCNN): unitary pooling with reproducible classical simulations across four classification tasks, documented in a co-authored manuscript. Option pricing (QOP): encoding comparisons for Asian-basket pricing, with reproducible logical-resource evidence and a manuscript draft. HF geolocation: hybrid ionospheric models and Gaussian-process correction, evaluated with simulated emitter geometry.
